analysis: Only base_text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (base lines 1-222 and 223-426) were supplied. No patch, head text, or other changed files were provided, so the PR's actual changes are not visible. Coverage is limited; this is not evidence that the PR is safe. The base changelog is documentation only and carries no executable security behavior. It describes controls that other changed files could affect: Autopilot reward authorization and its Nov 7, 2026 sunset (CHANGELOG.md:36-46, T-060/T-055), legacy MDM cohort freezing and App Attest gating (292-303, T-052..T-054/TB-011), provider-bound field minimization (274, T-051/T-003), SSD prefix cache write budget and TTL (85-86, 268, T-041), account erasure (131-149, T-059), Stripe payout/refund handling (65-67, 332-336, TB-008), and the soft-delete mutation gate default false (125). The integration pass should check whether any head-side code or docs diverge from these documented claims, particularly the TB-011 per-dispatch authorization, T-041 TTL and SEC-035, and T-059 erasure fences. No new attack surface or invalidated assumption can be established from this unit alone.
